message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to incoming data; argument parsing uses default values without validation beyond argparse's basic type coercion.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local filesystem path (data_root default is a local RAID path) with no checksum verification, signed URLs, or authentication of any remote source.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is implemented anywhere in the data-preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code creates models via create_model() which instantiates architectures from scratch; there is no evidence of loading pretrained weights with any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision control.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation enforcement, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model during inference.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs such as NaN guards, probability bounds, or threshold validation in the inference path visible in this code.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision-based few-shot classification pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
